description: Fail-closed cases for participant-level parallel randomized synthesis.

cases.reason: Required participant outcomes are complete-case inputs and are never silently deleted.
A requested model covariate must be present for every analyzed participant.
Every study must contain participants from both randomized arms.
Cluster, crossover, observational, and other participant-level designs require separately validated models.
Treatment-covariate interactions use covariates centered within study to avoid conflating within-study and across-study associations.
